title: Fix duplicate in-transit location in localized Contoso demo data
summary: The Contoso demo data now uses a single source for the in-transit location code across inventory and warehousing modules, eliminating duplicate location records in non-English locales.
key_points: Replaced the warehousing module's independent in-transit location definition with a call to the existing inventory module procedure
Removed the redundant translatable label that could cause different abbreviations in non-English languages
The duplicate-guard check now works correctly because both modules reference the same location code
The fix only applies to new demo data; existing databases with duplicates are not cleaned up
Safe to apply regardless of module initialization order since the function returns a constant
